notes:
Summary: Glacier is a regulated payments processor with EU customer base; strong requirement for EU-only data residency for EU customers, separate UK residency, and Canadian data handling for Canadian customers. They want a single private control plane deployed into their VPCs (per-region), with per-tenant routing to regioned model stacks.
POC goals: 1) Validate EU-only processing (Frankfurt) with no cross-region token export; 2) Achieve p95 tail latency <150ms for chat workflows under 100 rps; 3) Demonstrate embeddings indexing pipeline with <50ms per vector embed (batching allowed); 4) Validate KMS integration and key rotation + HSM-backed keys.
Security specifics from call: - Must support customer-managed KMS keys (AWS KMS CMKs for AWS-hosted VPCs, Azure Key Vault for Azure workloads). - HSM import/PKCS#11 supported for enterprise keys (customer uses Thales HSM). - Audit logging must ship to their SIEM over TLS (Splunk/QRadar) and be human readable for audit. Retention policy: 7 years for payment-affiliated logs.
Networking: VPC peering preferred; also open to PrivateLink for minimal egress. Egress control: no third-party telemetry outside region.
Operational ask: SRE-run Dedicated tier vs full Private deployment (customer leaning Private VPC). They want runbook for failover (UK fallback to EU only on outage), and automatic model variant fallbacks.
Quote from CTO: 'We cannot accept any stage where EU customer payloads cross non-EU infrastructure — that is non-negotiable.'
Documents: SOW draft requested; security FAQ + network diagram needed.
Internal notes: high commercial upside if we can meet DPA and KMS/hsm requirements; SE time estimated 8 days for POC; Dedicated capacity pricing may be requested post-POC.
poC_success_criteria: p95 latency <150ms for chat @100rps; embeddings batch throughput >=500 vectors/s with 95% success; no EU data egress; full KMS CMK signoff; SIEM log ingestion verified
networking_constraints: VPC peering + strict egress ACLs, customer-managed NAT, IP allowlist (security team will provide ranges), no public internet egress for payloads
legal_constraints: Must sign EU DPA with explicit data residency clause; UK adequacy separate exhibit; Canadian PII clause; 7yr audit log retention added to contract
cost_sensitivity: medium-high: willing to pay premium for regional isolation and KMS/HSM support but wants predictable committed pricing for Dedicated/Private
